# Kaleidoscope

> Local native memory for agents, exposed through a public manager CLI and persistent stdio MCP. Release status: staging (unreleased).

- [Documentation](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/): product and developer overview
- [Getting started](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/getting-started/): profile and reversible host setup
- [MCP reference](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/mcp/): exactly `search` and `remember`
- [Integrations](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/integrations/): Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, and generic MCP
- [Security and privacy](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/security/): local/account/data boundary and release integrity
- [Account](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/account/): login manages account/device state and does not upload local memory
- [Operations](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/operations/): backup, restore, uninstall, update, and exact vault deletion

The engine is proprietary object code. The manager, wrappers, integrations, and public skill are intended to be public after licensing approval. Hosted memory is planned, not available. Public contract SHA-256: not-yet-bound.
